text:
marta: Quick design review — proposed changes for Rollouts timeline/card: moving Rollback CTA out of the inline card to a fixed actions column so accidental clicks are less likely. Also adding a compact legend with explicit icons for canary/A/B/rollback states. Thoughts?

james: +1 on moving CTA. Feels dangerous in-card. Can we make rollback a secondary action and add a clear confirmation microcopy?

alejandro: Agree. Suggest copy: "Initiate rollback — This will revert traffic to the previous stable version. Not reversible from this view." Maybe include an extra step for Dedicated customers? :thinking:

tara: Accessibility nits: CTA needs a more distinct focus state, aria-label="Initiate rollback" and role="button" on timeline entries. Also color contrast for canary amber (#f5a623) vs bg fails 3:1. Consider pattern for colorblind — texture or icon in legend.

deploy-bot: Deploy window open for canary test 1828 — canary traffic 5% -> 20% scheduled.

marta: Good points. For the legend: small dot + letter (C/A/R) — that solves colorblind. Also tooltip on hover shows exact % and source of traffic (region/pool). Slider needs a numeric input fallback for keyboard users.

james: UX question: should A/B variants show inline metrics (latency/regression) or require click to expand? Inline might clutter. Maybe use a hover peek with quick stats and a link to full compare.

alejandro: For version history timeline, add compact mode that collapses intermediate patch releases and groups them under a chevron. Keyboard nav: left/right to move between versions, enter to open details.

tara: Also microcopy tweak: replace "Rollback" button text with "Start rollback" -> more conversational. But legal/compliance prefers "Initiate rollback" — we should align with security.

marta: Let's sync in design crit tomorrow 11am. I'll update the Figma with proposed legend, CTA placement, and focus states. Attaching quick mock: <figma link>

james: LGTM. Can we add an a11y checklist to PR template for rollout UI? small list: focus order, aria labels, color contrast, keyboard shortcuts.

marta: Will do. Thanks all. :heart:
